question: Related Questions Q. "In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful" Asalamo Alykum, I once had plans to go abroad for studies. I did an Isthekhara for it. I saw my father crying over some mutual business partners' loss and somebody telling me that my father is already burnt. It was such a painful dream that I woke up with tears in my eyes. I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I quit my plans for study abroad, and I have been trying for him to leave all Soodi investments. But when i think that the dream said "he is already burnt" i feel perhaps it is no use. The sin has amounted so much that Allah na karae, but he will burn in hell for sure. So I get disheartened. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. So I wonder, even if he takes out all his soodi investment, if the remorse is not there, perhaps he will not be forgiven for lack of Tauba. How do you interpret the dream? 2520 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31507 Country: India Title: Me and my wife is staying in USA, my wife is in H4 Visa(dependent Visa), in which she is not allowed to work in USA. One sister came Question: Assalamualikum, Me and my wife is staying in USA, my wife is in H4 Visa(dependent Visa), in which she is not allowed to work in USA. One sister came to my wife for applying mehendi and she gave some dollars, she did not accept, but if she accept, is it halal for us. Jazakallah Answer ID: 31507 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 752/752/M=1432) You should have accepted the dollars if she was not giving them as bribe and neither there was any reason to believe that they were earned out of haram income. Accepting hadya is sunnah and it is pure and halal. Yes, if it is known with surety that it is not halal for you, then there is no harm in rejecting it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
